name: Combobox
label: Combobox
description: A filterable select that narrows options as the user types, with multi-select chips, grouping, and async loading.

props.name: label
props.description: Combobox label text

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown in the text field when nothing is selected

props.name: value
props.description:
Selected value, controlled — a `string` in single mode, `string[]` when
`multiple` is set. Leave undefined to let the combobox keep its own
selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Selection on first render when uncontrolled (`value` undefined) — a
`string` in single mode, `string[]` when `multiple` is set. Omitted, the
selection starts empty.

props.name: options
props.description: Available options (flat list)

props.name: groups
props.description: Optional grouped options — when provided, `options` is ignored

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow selecting more than one option; selections render as removable chips

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the combobox is disabled

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the combobox is required

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — shows error styling and message

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message displayed below the field

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading affordance in the menu — for async option fetching

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when the filter matches no options

props.name: loadingMessage
props.description: Status text shown in the menu while `loading` is set. Defaults to "Loading…".

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button once something is selected

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to "Clear selection".

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of a chip's remove button in `multiple` mode, given the
option's label. Defaults to "Remove <label>".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new selection — a `string` in single mode,
`string[]` when `multiple` is set.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called as the user types, for async/server-side filtering

props.name: manualFiltering
props.description: Skip built-in filtering — use when options are filtered upstream

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the selection submits with an enclosing form
under this name through hidden inputs: the selected option's `value` in
single mode (nothing while no value is set), one entry per selected value in
`multiple` mode, nothing while disabled. The search text the user types
is never submitted. Also the fallback for the element id (`id || name || generated`).
